rows.label: tlk45320651_10_msg0001
rows.name:
Hmm... I don't know what I'm supposed
to do if this is left to me.

rows.label: tlk45320651_10_msg0003
rows.name:
Apparently, it's become necessary to
dramatically increase the pace of our
mineralogy and forestry studies.

rows.label: tlk45320651_10_msg0004
rows.name:
So we urgently need the latest
information delivered by researchers
observing things in the field.

rows.label: tlk45320651_10_msg0005
rows.name:
I'm in the Operations Testing Bureau,
not Information Headquarters. I'm
certainly no messenger.

rows.label: tlk45320651_10_msg0006
rows.name:
It seems quite illogical
that I should be assigned
to a task of this nature...

rows.label: tlk45320651_10_msg0008
rows.name:
I think it's just a procedural error,
but can I leave it to you?

rows.label: tlk45320651_10_msg0009
rows.name:
Looks like you can handle it reliably.
I'm counting on you!
